_comment: HARD INVARIANTS are laws and must never regress. PERFORMANCE BANDS are derived from the measured distribution and are host/network sensitive: they are guidance, not law. Do not promote a band to a law by tightening it until it fails on a slow morning.

certified.fixture: Firefly Early Learning — Waitlist Work Unit, 17-child stressed case

hard_invariants._comment: Violating any of these fails certification outright, at any latency.
hard_invariants.focus_panel_subtree_mounts_once_per_entr: card-bearing sections only; WU-08 seed-header handoff is intentional and free

performance_bands._comment: p50 measured on deployed staging over 3 cold samples; bands allow for host and network variance. A band breach is a signal to investigate, not an automatic failure.

retired_findings.organization_1343ms: Dev-mode Turbopack on-demand compilation. Does not reproduce on deployed staging (~438-951ms). Never re-open from a dev measurement.

known_open.duplicate_placement_candidates: DEFECT. Prevention deployed (placementCandidateSubjectUniqueness). Repair deliberately gated — its survivor rule oscillated on real tenant data — and belongs to a separate governed mission. Staging residue is expected, not a certification failure.
known_open.baseline_red_tests: As of bcd20f004, 32 pre-existing test failures across 17 files. The method is to compare failing test NAMES against the baseline commit, never counts — but see suite_cannot_complete: that method currently cannot be executed repo-wide.
known_open.suite_cannot_complete: BLOCKER for the non-regression method, measured 2026-09-06 on a worktree based at 0fbeaa02a. The full vitest run aborts instead of finishing: tests/adminV2/runtime/householdConfigureCanvas.render.test.tsx emits 16 unhandled rejections (ERR_INVALID_URL, input '/api/admin/locations?hierarchy=1') from useInquiryChildPlacementCascade.ts:74 -> dedupeAdminFetchWithTtl -> undici fetch, which requires an absolute URL. In isolation vitest tolerates them and the file reports 1 passed / 2 tests passed — a green file that is not clean. Under --maxWorkers=2 the same rejections kill the worker fork and the broker classifies the run 'FAILED TO START (CLI/config error, not a test failure)'. Consequence: 'compare failing test NAMES against the baseline' cannot be performed repo-wide until this is fixed. Likely fix: give the dedupe layer an absolute base in test environments, or stub fetch in the render harness. Not repaired here — it is product-path code and outside this mission's scope.

_measurement_history_comment: Trajectory, so 'is Alloy getting faster?' is answerable with evidence rather than recollection. Appending a measurement NEVER rewrites `certified` or `performance_bands`: a baseline is advanced only on a proven improvement with no hard-invariant regression, and is never moved to accommodate a slower change.

waitlist_tier3.note: First actual execution of this spec. Write -> canonical read -> rendered order -> reload -> clear -> restore, against deployed staging.

measurement_history.regression_signal: rows / first_useful_card p50 went 2496ms -> 4690ms (+88%). Within band_max 5000 so no BAND WARNING fired and the verdict is correctly PASS - bands are guidance, not law - but this is 94% of band_max on the metric already ranked the largest single operator-visible wait. Treat as REGRESS-signal under the continuous-improvement policy and investigate BEFORE any thought of widening the band. 3 cold samples, and 27+ commits separate the two revisions, so this is a signal to investigate, not a proven single-cause regression.
measurement_history.note: Measured after the harness probe-integrity fix; waitlist reported DELEGATED, not silently passed.
